paras: Unlock the perfect blend of daily drivability and signature Subaru sound with the XForce Street Cat-Back Exhaust System for your VB WRX. Crafted for enthusiasts who want a noticeable tone without overwhelming volume, this system brings balanced sound and standout styling to your build.

Featuring a 3” mandrel-bent centre section , the system splits into twin 2.5” rear sections , channelling exhaust gases smoothly through twin XForce oval rear mufflers for a refined yet sporty note. Whether you're navigating the city or hitting the open road, this system delivers a deep tone without intrusive cabin drone—ideal for everyday driving.
